QuestInfo.name: [Commerci Republic] Parbell, World's 'Greatest' Explorer
QuestInfo.0: There's an old man you've never met before on the pier in Lith Harbor. He's calling our your name like you're a long-lost friend... could this be Parbell, the Explorer that Neinheart spoke of?
QuestInfo.2: You got on the ship to Commerci with Parbell the Explorer, whom you met at Lith Harbor, but you were knocked overboard and washed ashore in an strange fishing village. Where is this place...?
